theme.en: HBM Integration Reshapes AI Hardware Supply

dek.en: Nvidia's push to take a more direct role in high-bandwidth memory lands as CXMT, memory makers, equipment suppliers, and foundries reposition around AI systems. The common constraint is shifting from a standalone memory stack to the links, base dies, packaging, and capacity that make scale-up compute possible.
dek.zh: Nvidia更直接介入高带宽存储器之际，CXMT、存储厂商、设备供应商和晶圆厂都在围绕AI系统重新布局。共同的约束正在从单一HBM堆叠，转向支撑大规模计算的互连、base die、封装与产能。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: Nvidia targets HBM with NVHBM and expands NVLink Fusion
title.zh: Nvidia瞄准HBM环节，推进NVHBM并扩展NVLink Fusion

summary.en: DigiTimes reports that Nvidia is pursuing custom NVHBM while expanding NVLink Fusion. The move would extend Nvidia's influence beyond GPU design into the memory and scale-up fabric surrounding AI accelerators. It also raises the stakes for HBM suppliers and partners as system-level bandwidth becomes a product differentiator.
summary.zh: DigiTimes报道称，Nvidia正推进定制NVHBM，并扩展NVLink Fusion。此举将把Nvidia的影响力从GPU设计延伸至AI加速器周边的存储与scale-up互连。随着系统级带宽成为产品差异化因素，HBM供应商及合作伙伴面临的竞争也将加剧。

title.en: Nvidia NVSwitch becomes a long-run scale-up networking bet
title.zh: Nvidia将NVSwitch押注为长期scale-up网络

summary.en: The Next Platform argues that NVSwitch is becoming Nvidia's durable scale-up networking layer, analogous to the role InfiniBand played in scale-out systems. That framing matters because accelerator performance increasingly depends on how efficiently multiple GPUs and their memory pools operate as one machine. It makes the interconnect stack a central part of AI hardware economics rather than an accessory.
summary.zh: The Next Platform认为，NVSwitch正成为Nvidia长期的scale-up网络层，类似InfiniBand在scale-out系统中的角色。其重要性在于，加速器性能日益取决于多颗GPU及其内存池能否高效地作为一台机器协同工作。这使互连堆栈成为AI硬件经济性中的核心，而不再只是附属组件。

title.en: Microchip reduces PolarFire sensor-bridge footprint for edge AI
title.zh: Microchip缩小面向边缘AI的PolarFire传感器桥接方案尺寸

summary.en: Microchip's second-generation PolarFire Ethernet sensor bridge reduces board footprint while adding camera support and Ethernet connectivity for edge-AI designs. The product targets the integration work between sensors, networking, and local inference rather than datacenter training. Smaller bridge hardware can matter where industrial and vision systems are constrained by board area and I/O complexity.
summary.zh: Microchip第二代PolarFire Ethernet传感器桥接方案在缩小板级面积的同时，增加了相机支持和Ethernet连接能力，面向边缘AI设计。该产品聚焦传感器、网络和本地推理之间的集成，而非数据中心训练。在工业和视觉系统中，板卡面积与I/O复杂度受限，因此更小的桥接硬件具有实际意义。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: Intel 14A shows faster-than-expected defect progress
title.zh: Intel 14A的缺陷改善快于预期

summary.en: SemiWiki reports that Intel's 14A process is reducing defect density faster than the company expected. Early defect learning is important because it affects both a node's manufacturability and Intel Foundry's credibility with external customers. The report is an early process signal, not a declaration of volume-production readiness.
summary.zh: SemiWiki报道称，Intel 14A工艺的缺陷密度下降速度快于公司预期。早期缺陷学习曲线关系到节点的可制造性，也影响Intel Foundry在外部客户中的可信度。这仍是早期工艺信号，并不等同于已具备量产就绪状态。

title.en: TSMC executive sees silicon photonics driving AI growth
title.zh: TSMC高管称硅光子将驱动AI增长

summary.en: A TSMC vice president said silicon photonics is expected to play a leading role in AI growth, according to the Taipei Times. Optical links address the bandwidth and power costs of moving data between increasingly large compute and memory domains. The comment connects foundry roadmaps to the same interconnect bottleneck highlighted by NVLink and HBM developments.
summary.zh: 据Taipei Times报道，一名TSMC副总裁表示，硅光子有望在AI增长中发挥主导作用。光互连可应对在日益庞大的计算与存储域之间搬运数据时的带宽和功耗成本。这一表态把晶圆厂路线图与NVLink和HBM所凸显的同一互连瓶颈联系起来。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: CXMT is reportedly producing HBM3E in small batches
title.zh: 报道称CXMT正小批量生产HBM3E

summary.en: XenoSpectrum reports that China's CXMT has begun small-batch HBM3E production and that AI-chip makers are testing the parts. If confirmed in qualified products, the development would give China's memory industry a foothold in a segment dominated by established HBM suppliers. Small-batch output and customer testing remain materially different from sustained, high-yield volume supply.
summary.zh: XenoSpectrum报道称，中国CXMT已开始小批量生产HBM3E，AI芯片厂商正在测试相关产品。若能在通过认证的产品中得到确认，这将使中国存储产业进入长期由既有HBM供应商主导的细分市场。但小批量产出和客户测试，与持续、高良率的大规模供应仍有实质差别。

title.en: Kioxia and SanDisk plan more than $31 billion for Japanese NAND
title.zh: Kioxia与SanDisk计划在日本投入逾310亿美元扩充NAND

summary.en: Kioxia and SanDisk plan more than $31 billion of Japanese investment through 2032 to expand advanced NAND capacity, EE Times Asia reports. The long investment horizon signals a supply-side commitment beyond the immediate AI-memory cycle. It also places NAND manufacturing and supply resilience alongside the industry's higher-profile HBM buildout.
summary.zh: EE Times Asia报道称，Kioxia和SanDisk计划到2032年在日本投资逾310亿美元，以扩大先进NAND产能。长期投资周期显示，这是一项超越眼前AI存储周期的供给侧承诺。它也使NAND制造与供应韧性在备受关注的HBM扩产之外获得更多位置。

title.en: Equipment & Materials
title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: Applied Materials develops 3D-scaling materials for HBM and CPO
title.zh: Applied Materials为HBM和CPO开发3D缩放材料

summary.en: TheElec reports that Applied Materials is developing materials and 3D-scaling technologies aimed at HBM and co-packaged optics (CPO). Both applications increase the importance of deposition, patterning, bonding, and thermal-control steps around heterogeneous integration. The equipment opportunity therefore follows not just wafer starts, but a growing number of complex assembly and interconnect layers per AI system.
summary.zh: TheElec报道称，Applied Materials正在开发面向HBM和co-packaged optics（CPO）的材料及3D缩放技术。两类应用都提升了异构集成中沉积、图形化、键合和热管理步骤的重要性。因此，设备机会不只取决于晶圆投片量，也取决于每套AI系统中不断增加的复杂封装和互连层数。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: Chinese court freezes $300 million of Nexperia assets
title.zh: 中国法院在Wingtech案中冻结Nexperia 3亿美元资产

summary.en: Reuters reports that a Chinese court froze $300 million of Nexperia assets in a case involving Wingtech. The dispute adds a legal and ownership risk to a supplier with a broad footprint in discrete and automotive semiconductors. It illustrates how cross-border chip operations can be disrupted by proceedings outside the fabrication line itself.
summary.zh: Reuters报道称，中国一家法院在涉及Wingtech的案件中冻结了Nexperia价值3亿美元的资产。这场纠纷为一家在分立器件和汽车半导体领域布局广泛的供应商增加了法律与所有权风险。它说明跨境芯片业务也可能因产线之外的司法程序而受到干扰。

title.en: Challengers
title.zh: 挑战者

title.en: SambaNova emphasizes dataflow for AI inference
title.zh: SambaNova强调面向AI推理的数据流架构

summary.en: Jon Peddie Research highlights SambaNova's dataflow approach to AI inference. The focus underscores that challengers are competing on how models, weights, and activations move through a system, not simply on peak arithmetic throughput. That positioning is especially relevant as inference deployments face memory-bandwidth and latency limits.
summary.zh: Jon Peddie Research关注SambaNova面向AI推理的数据流方法。这一重点表明，挑战者竞争的不仅是峰值算力，更是模型、权重和激活值如何在系统中流动。随着推理部署面临存储带宽和延迟限制，这种定位尤其相关。

theme.zh: 以存储为中心的计算更加可编程

dek.en: New measured CIM macros pursue programmable arithmetic and higher-precision data paths, while device and system papers seek denser memory and lower data movement. The research queue also follows the design and deployment tooling needed to make those hardware gains useful.
dek.zh: 新的实测CIM宏单元追求可编程算术与更高精度的数据路径，器件和系统论文则探索更高密度的存储与更少的数据搬运。研究队列同时关注让这些硬件收益真正落地所需的设计与部署工具。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: PROTEUS: programmable RRAM/SRAM compute-in-memory for edge AI
title.zh: PROTEUS：面向边缘AI的可编程RRAM/SRAM存算一体加速器

papers.authors: L. Zheng, A. M. Bavani, M. Chen, et al.

summary.en: PROTEUS is a 40 nm programmable digital CIM accelerator combining 4 Mb RRAM, 2.6 Mb tensor SRAM, and a 32-bit hierarchical ISA. It supports INT8, INT16, FP8, and FP16 execution and reports 702 GOPS, 6.4 TOPS/W, and 0.039 TOPS/mm². By storing micro-programs in RRAM, it can switch among preloaded kernels without off-chip instruction traffic or RRAM rewrites; the reported results cover CNNs, Transformers, GNNs, and state-space models.
summary.zh: PROTEUS是一款40 nm可编程数字CIM加速器，集成4 Mb RRAM、2.6 Mb tensor SRAM和32位分层ISA。它支持INT8、INT16、FP8和FP16运算，报告的性能为702 GOPS、6.4 TOPS/W和0.039 TOPS/mm²。通过把微程序存入RRAM，该设计可在预载内核之间切换而无需片外指令流或重写RRAM；实验覆盖CNN、Transformer、GNN和state-space model。

title.en: STAR-SRAM: BF16 SRAM digital CIM macro in 28 nm
title.zh: STAR-SRAM：28 nm BF16 SRAM数字存算一体宏单元

papers.authors: C.-T. Lin, J. Oh, M. Seok

summary.en: STAR-SRAM implements a 16-bit BF16 SRAM-based digital CIM macro in 28 nm CMOS. Its designers combine model-based parameter selection with approximate multipliers and sparsity-aware wordline, clock, and input gating. The paper reports up to 43.06 TFLOPS/W, 1.89 TFLOPS/mm², and 400 Kb/mm², directly targeting the precision and density gap between low-bit CIM and modern neural workloads.
summary.zh: STAR-SRAM在28 nm CMOS中实现了基于SRAM的16位BF16数字CIM宏单元。设计团队结合基于模型的参数选择、近似乘法器，以及稀疏性感知的wordline、时钟和输入门控。论文报告最高43.06 TFLOPS/W、1.89 TFLOPS/mm²和400 Kb/mm²，直接瞄准低比特CIM与现代神经网络工作负载之间的精度和密度缺口。

title.en: NOVA: near-memory processing for attention–SSM–MoE LLMs
title.zh: NOVA：面向Attention–SSM–MoE大模型的近存计算

papers.authors: I. Jung, J. Min, J.-Y. Kim

summary.en: NOVA proposes a technology–architecture co-design for hybrid LLMs that combine grouped-query attention, state-space models, and MoE layers. It pairs a proposed 4F² vertical-channel DRAM cell and peri-over-cell structure, claimed to provide roughly 2× density at iso-area, with a near-memory architecture that adapts to disparate arithmetic intensities. The work is a preprint, so its density and system claims should be read as a proposed design rather than production silicon results.
summary.zh: NOVA提出了针对混合LLM的技术—架构协同设计，此类模型结合grouped-query attention、state-space model和MoE层。它将所提出的4F² vertical-channel DRAM单元及peri-over-cell结构——声称在等面积下约有2倍密度——与能适配不同算术强度的近存计算架构结合。该工作是预印本，因此其密度和系统主张应视为设计方案，而非量产硅片结果。

title.en: Devices & Process
title.zh: 器件与工艺

title.en: Electroforming-free selector-only memory for logic-in-memory
title.zh: 用于逻辑存内计算的免电形成selector-only memory

papers.authors: J.-K. Kim, D.-S. Woo, M.-J. Han, et al.

summary.en: This paper reports an electroforming-free, self-rectifying selector-only memory based on diffusive Cu-ion dynamics. The device combines diode-like unidirectional current with reported endurance near 10⁸ cycles and sub-20 ns self-rupturing conductive filaments. Eliminating high-voltage forming and reducing drift could address practical array concerns for 3D cross-point memory and logic-in-memory, although array-level integration remains the key test.
summary.zh: 该论文报告了一种基于扩散Cu离子动力学的免电形成、自整流selector-only memory。该器件兼具类似二极管的单向电流，报告的耐久度接近10⁸次，并具有小于20 ns的导电细丝自断裂特性。免除高压forming并降低漂移，有望缓解3D cross-point memory和logic-in-memory的阵列实现难题，但阵列级集成仍是关键验证。

title.en: Wafer-scale 3D ternary neuromorphic logic using Te/IGZO devices
title.zh: 基于Te/IGZO器件的晶圆级3D三值神经形态逻辑

papers.authors: C.-H. Kim, M. S. Kim, J. B. Rhim, et al.

summary.en: The authors demonstrate wafer-scale monolithic 3D multi-valued logic using vertically stacked Te/IGZO heterojunction FETs and crystallinity-enhanced Te FETs. Interface and channel engineering stabilize an intrinsic ternary state using low-temperature CMOS-compatible processing. The result points to a route for higher logic density, but the architectural benefit depends on system-level support for ternary logic rather than device behavior alone.
summary.zh: 作者利用垂直堆叠的Te/IGZO异质结FET和结晶性增强Te FET，展示了晶圆级单片3D多值逻辑。界面和沟道工程在低温CMOS兼容工艺下稳定了内禀三值状态。该结果指向更高逻辑密度的路径，但其架构收益还取决于系统级对三值逻辑的支持，而不仅是器件特性。

title.en: Circuits & Systems
title.zh: 电路与系统

title.en: Dual-mode BEV Transformer accelerator for image/point-cloud fusion
title.zh: 用于图像/点云融合的双模式BEV Transformer加速器

papers.authors: J. Qian, Y. Lu, Z. Qian, et al.

summary.en: A 28 nm chip accelerates Transformer bird's-eye-view perception by combining saliency-driven image/point-cloud fusion, adaptive precision, and a dataflow designed to reuse on-chip data. It supports a high-performance driving mode and a low-power sentry mode, with 26.6 mW active power and 1.68 mW long-term average power reported for sparse-activity scenarios. The dual-mode design addresses a practical autonomous-system problem: retaining perception capability when full compute throughput is unnecessary.
summary.zh: 这款28 nm芯片通过显著性驱动的图像/点云融合、自适应精度和面向片上数据复用的数据流，加速Transformer鸟瞰图感知。它支持高性能驾驶模式和低功耗哨兵模式；在稀疏活动场景中，报告的active power为26.6 mW、长期平均功耗为1.68 mW。该双模式设计解决了自动驾驶系统中的实际问题：在不需要完整计算吞吐时仍保留感知能力。

title.en: AI Systems & Inference
title.zh: AI系统与推理

title.en: Hydra: phase-aware characterization of edge LLM inference
title.zh: Hydra：面向边缘LLM推理的阶段感知性能刻画

papers.authors: A. Taherin, S. Taghipour Anvari, C. Amante, et al.

summary.en: Hydra provides a common-schema measurement framework for prefill and decode phases across three edge-SoC generations, 13 instruction-tuned LLMs, five execution formats, and two inference backends. Its released dataset contains roughly 107,000 per-prompt records combined with hardware telemetry. The analysis argues that latency averages conceal important effects from backend choice, quantization, memory traffic, and phase-specific utilization.
summary.zh: Hydra提供统一schema的测量框架，用于比较三代edge SoC、13个指令微调LLM、5种执行格式和两种推理后端上的prefill与decode阶段。其公开数据集包含约10.7万条逐prompt记录，并结合硬件遥测数据。分析指出，平均延迟掩盖了后端选择、量化、内存流量和阶段特定利用率带来的重要影响。

title.en: Event-triggered implicit perturbation for fine-tuning spiking Transformers
title.zh: 用于微调脉冲Transformer的事件触发隐式扰动方法

papers.authors: T. Lei, P. Katti, R. Dutt, et al.

summary.en: This preprint proposes implicit perturbation for zeroth-order fine-tuning of spiking Transformers on in-memory-computing hardware. It combines perturbation terms with IMC weighted sums to avoid perturbation-induced read-modify-write operations, and exploits spike sparsity to reduce random-number-generator requirements. The idea addresses a hardware-specific obstacle in forward-only optimization, though its claimed benefits require validation on a complete accelerator implementation.
summary.zh: 该预印本提出用于IMC硬件上脉冲Transformer zeroth-order微调的隐式扰动方法。它将扰动项与IMC加权和结合，以避免由扰动引起的read-modify-write操作，并利用脉冲稀疏性降低对随机数发生器的需求。该思路针对仅前向优化中的硬件特定障碍，但其所宣称的收益仍需在完整加速器实现上验证。

title.en: EDA & Design Automation
title.zh: EDA与设计自动化

title.en: DeepSeq3: hierarchical graph learning for sequential-circuit analysis
title.zh: DeepSeq3：用于时序电路分析的分层图学习

papers.authors: J. Zhou, Z. Shi, J. Zhu, et al.

summary.en: DeepSeq3 represents a sequential circuit at two levels: combinational subgraphs divided by flip-flops and a super-node graph for register-transfer structure. A dual GNN is pre-trained to predict flip-flop-state reachability, capturing both local logic and temporal behavior. On the reported benchmarks, the framework reduces bounded-model-checking solve time by 18% while preserving correctness, though results remain limited to the evaluated designs.
summary.zh: DeepSeq3以两个层级表示时序电路：由flip-flop划分的组合子图，以及表达寄存器传输结构的super-node图。双GNN通过预测flip-flop状态可达性进行预训练，同时捕捉局部逻辑和时序行为。在报告的基准上，该框架在保持正确性的前提下将bounded model checking求解时间降低18%，但结果仍限于所评估的设计。

title.en: HOLMES: in-context failure localization for SRAM yield estimation
title.zh: HOLMES：用于SRAM良率估计的in-context失效中心定位

papers.authors: W. W. Xing, X. Zhou, K. Huang, et al.

summary.en: HOLMES recasts failure-center localization for high-sigma yield estimation as few-shot binary classification using a tabular foundation model. It adds an SVD-based anisotropic sampling proposal and adaptive mixing to stabilize importance weights in high-dimensional SRAM problems. Across the authors' 6T SRAM cases from 108 to 1,152 dimensions, HOLMES reports relative error within 5.9%, compared with up to 25.8% for the strongest baseline.
summary.zh: HOLMES将high-sigma良率估计中的失效中心定位重构为few-shot二分类，并采用tabular foundation model进行in-context推理。它增加了基于SVD的各向异性采样proposal和自适应混合，以稳定高维SRAM问题中的importance weights。在作者的6T SRAM案例中，维度从108到1,152，HOLMES报告的相对误差不超过5.9%，而最强baseline最高达到25.8%。
